text.en: Clients express strong appreciation for Dr Casey, Dr Garthe, and their veterinary technicians during both in-clinic visits and mobile house calls. Pet owners praise the team for thorough consultations and compassionate bedside manners. One reviewer complained about delays in prescription communication over the telephone, but the majority describe supportive and polite practitioners.

Pet owners report positive health outcomes for routine examinations, soft tissue surgeries, and urgent palliative treatments. Reviewers mention that clinicians quickly hydrate dehydrated rescue animals, manage chronic pain in older pets, and offer holistic medical alternatives alongside standard care. Clients appreciate the clinic's thoughtful medical decision-making.

Clients commend the practitioners for their considerate and reassuring approach towards senior cats, rescue felines, and golden doodles. Reviewers note that having veterinary clinicians visit the home significantly lessens stress for vulnerable animals. Pet owners describe staff taking care to minimise pain and discomfort during hands-on evaluations.

q.en: Does the practice provide mobile veterinary house calls?

a.en: Yes, clients confirm that mobile veterinary units visit homes across the area for exams, pain management, and urgent pet care.

q.en: Are surgical procedures performed at the hospital?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention successful surgeries, including procedures for golden doodles, conducted at the physical practice.

q.en: Can older cats receive pain relief and alternative therapies?

a.en: Yes, pet owners note that clinicians evaluate senior cats thoroughly and offer conventional pain management as well as holistic options.
The practice prioritises scheduled appointments and urgent cases, occasionally adjusting schedules when handling medical emergencies.
